contract.note: The substantive criteria fairly test expected full-year margins and knowing acceptance of a material reduction. The realized metric label conflicts with that framing; realized results alone cannot resolve it.

evidence.note: Anthropic's timely company disclosure confirms the compute agreement, but supplies neither pricing nor its effect on margins or management's knowledge.
The filing was available before the cutoff. Its positive first-half GAAP margin concerns a different period and potentially different basis; it does not isolate the agreement's effect.

reviews.rationale: The agreement is documented, but comparable pre- and post-agreement 2026 projections, incremental costs and revenue, and evidence of knowing acceptance are absent. Positive first-half margins warrant consideration but cannot settle the full-year baseline or causal claim on an unspecified accounting basis.

contract.note: Reading earnings as revenue under the cited contracts is ordinary. Requiring limited capacity throughout relevant delivery periods preserves the antecedent without treating an isolated delay as decisive.

evidence.note: This timely company disclosure describes staged capacity plans and commitments. It establishes neither persistently limited deliveries nor realized contract revenue.

reviews.rationale: The limited-capacity antecedent is unestablished, so the conditional cannot be scored. No deadline was stated, and the packet contains no realization, termination, or settlement satisfying the early-resolution rule. Interim plans or delays establish neither success nor failure.
